businesses.business: digital advertising verification and measurement software

offering_description.value: Provides a software platform that verifies and measures digital advertising quality for advertisers, agencies and publishers. It checks brand safety, fraud, viewability, suitability and attention, and offers performance optimization tools. Delivered as cloud-based analytics across web, mobile, connected TV and social.

primary_products.value: ad verification software; brand safety and suitability tools; ad fraud detection; viewability and attention measurement; campaign performance optimization software

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, advertising agencies, publishers, and ad platforms such as social and streaming media companies

end_markets.value: digital advertising; media and publishing; social media; connected TV and streaming; marketing agencies

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees based on volume of ad impressions measured, verified or activated; subscription: platform access and contracted measurement services

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates cloud measurement and analytics platform integrated into ad campaigns, sold to advertisers, agencies and publishers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: verification, measurement and optimization tools for digital advertising

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to advertisers, agencies and publishers; partners / resellers: integrations with ad platforms and programmatic buying platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules such as GDPR and CCPA, advertising measurement accreditation by industry bodies such as MRC
